value.title: Opening & Ending Encyclopedia
value.synopsis: The various openings and endings to the series along with some explanations to certain photos in those openings and endings.

value.title: Scenes From the Dark Tournament
value.synopsis: Shows two short additional clips from the Dark Tournament Saga In part one, Koto attempts to interview Team Urameshi (who are all silent and ready for battle) but is frightened by their answers. When Kurama starts exuding the aura of his Yoko form, she runs away and is pelted by trash thrown by the audience for her failure. In part, two Team Urameshi and friends take the picture seen at the end of the season's ED
